release_notes: Vortex PT v1.0.3 Release - Complete ADAPT-Builder Beam & Elevation Cross-Section Reconstruction (extracts downstand & upstand beams, level variations, and accurate soffit tracking), strict Anchor Topology guarantee (anchors strictly at tendon ends, 0 interior false anchors, direct ADAPT chair extraction with custom deductions and rounding), and universal Tendon Spacing Dimensions for inclined tendons, multiple orientation clusters, and short tendon bridging.
